_note: Market sentiment knobs (generic_utils.market_sentiment). The floor, windows, quintiles and the arrow rule are measurement settings, not cutoffs; what to do with a reading (timing, size, hedges) stays the judgment's. No composite: families count measured arrows, they are never summed into a score.

ret_cap.label: Day, cap-weighted %
ret_cap.read: The market's move at scan time.

ret_5.label: 5 sessions, cap index %
ret_5.read: Short-term trend of the cap-weighted floor.

ret_21.label: 21 sessions, cap index %
ret_21.read: Month trend of the cap-weighted floor.

dd.label: Cap index under its store high %
dd.read: 0 = at the high; deeper = a drawdown under way.

cap_med.label: Cap minus median name, day pp
cap_med.read: Positive = megacaps carry the day (narrow); negative = the median name leads.

adv_10.label: Names up, 10-session mean %
adv_10.read: Breadth thrust when it jumps from under 40 to over 60.

above50_pct.label: Over the 50-day %
above50_pct.read: Intermediate participation; extremes are stretched or washed out.

nh_nl.label: Near 52w high minus near 52w low, % of names
nh_nl.read: Positive = more names at highs than at lows.

nl_pct.label: Near the 52-week low %
nl_pct.read: Rising with the index up = a divergence.

upvol_pct.label: Up-volume share %
upvol_pct.read: Share of traded volume in names up on the day (robust to an intraday scan).

upvol_10.label: Up-volume share, 10-session mean %
upvol_10.read: Accumulation (high) or distribution (low) over two weeks.

vol_pace.label: Volume pace vs 30-day average (x)
vol_pace.read: Total volume over the 30-day average, scaled for the share of the session elapsed at scan time (rough on intraday files).

dist_25.label: Distribution days in 25 sessions
dist_25.read: Cap index down 0.2%+ on higher volume pace than the session before.

acc_25.label: Accumulation days in 25 sessions
acc_25.read: Cap index up 0.2%+ on higher volume pace than the session before.

disp.label: Dispersion of day moves (stdev pp)
disp.read: High = a stock-picker's or a stressed tape.

beta_spread_10.label: High minus low beta tercile, 10-session mean pp
beta_spread_10.read: Risk appetite: positive = high beta leads.

mom_spread_10.label: Prior month winners minus losers, 10-session mean pp

def_spread_10.label: Defensive sectors minus all, 10-session mean pp
def_spread_10.read: Positive = money hiding in utilities / staples / health services.

ai_spread_5.label: AI cluster minus market, 5 sessions pp
ai_spread_5.read: The AI cluster's lead or lag against the cap-weighted floor.

beat_rx.label: Reaction to beats, last 10 sessions %
beat_rx.read: What a beat earns now; low = a demanding market.

beats_sold_pct.label: Beats sold on the day %
beats_sold_pct.read: Share of beats that fell on the reaction session: high = priced for perfection.

miss_rx.label: Reaction to misses, last 10 sessions %
miss_rx.read: How hard misses are punished; mild = forgiving.

rev_breadth.label: EPS estimates up minus down (1 month), % of names

pt_rev_breadth.label: Targets up minus down (1 month), % of names

tech_buy_pct.label: TradingView technical rating buy %
tech_buy_pct.read: Share of names with a positive technical rating.

p_exh_med.label: Median exhaustion score (move prediction)
p_exh_med.read: The move-prediction model's exhaustion read across names.

p_frag_med.label: Median fragility score (move prediction)
p_frag_med.read: The move-prediction model's fragility read across names.

p_bo_med.label: Median breakout score (move prediction)
p_bo_med.read: The move-prediction model's breakout read across names.

mtp_enter_pct.label: MTP ENTER share %
mtp_enter_pct.read: Market timing policy: ENTER_SMALL + ENTER_PROBE as a share of its book (climate, never a buy list).

patterns.name: distribution_cluster
patterns.read: Five or more distribution days in 25 sessions: institutions selling into the tape.

patterns.name: capitulation_day
patterns.read: A 85%+ down day by names and volume.

patterns.name: thrust_day
patterns.read: A 85%+ up day by names and volume.

patterns.name: follow_through
patterns.read: After a 3%+ drawdown, a 1.2%+ up day on rising volume.

patterns.name: narrow_up
patterns.read: Index up while most names fall: megacaps carry the tape.

patterns.name: hidden_strength
patterns.read: Index down while most names rise: rotation under the surface.

patterns.name: lows_divergence
patterns.read: Index up on the week while 4%+ of names sit near their 52-week low.

patterns.name: washed_out
patterns.read: A quarter or fewer of names over their 50-day.

patterns.name: stretched
patterns.read: Three quarters over the 50-day and 12%+ overbought.

patterns.name: beats_sold
patterns.read: Half or more of recent beats sold on the day: expectations run ahead.

patterns.name: momentum_unwind
patterns.read: Last month's winners lag its losers by 0.4 pp a day over two weeks.

patterns.name: risk_off_rotation
patterns.read: Defensives lead and high beta lags.

patterns.name: ai_lags
patterns.read: The AI cluster trails the market by 3 pp or more over five sessions.
